cause:not-a-round-2-regression-the-wave3.text: Not a round-2 regression: the wave3 13.6 ms build was an all-reused rebuild inside a 480-build storm, not a planned build. A cold build costs 220.7 ms offline on .NET8 (about 1 s on Mono).

cause:not-pit-pathing-no-pit-exists-on-t.text: Not pit pathing: no pit exists on that map (the script digs nothing; excavatedCellCount 0), and RM_PitPathing/RM_PitStepCost only act on cells with ClimbDepthAt > 0.

cause:reading-b-that-the-1-4x-ratio-was.text: Reading (b), that the 1.4x ratio was never meant for a 2-cell lead and the criterion is wrong: refuted by the owner's card, which says the 1.4x bar applies to every cord and the builder must make short leads droop more; bar unchanged.

cause:remaining-class-6-squared-shoulder.text: Remaining class-6 squared shoulders are not the strip pose: PoseStrip route exhausted; 150,113 is a hop round blocked cell 150,114 (wall forces it) and 180,102's transmitter corner trades for two socket bends.

cause:round-3-s-claim-that-the-solar-pan.text: Round 3's claim that the solar panels sit on no net was wrong per owner; but the record then showed SolarGenerator transmitsPower=true, so the 6-cell connectParent search does not apply and t39713/t39714 touch nothing and are unpowered in vanilla.

cause:the-2026-11-03-07-42z-live-fail.text: The 2026-11-03 07:42Z live FAIL on A1 was a harness fault: the proof ran under WSL python3 and raised RimBridgeError (no route to Windows loopback); it measured nothing.

cause:the-44-6-ms-first-slice-after-rese.text: The 44.6 ms first slice after reset (C lamp, r9) was not a pause: gap 0.006 ms, gc0/1/2 0/0/0, lay and graph workers idle. It came from snapClone 20.5 + tail 14.8 + snapPower 5.6 + build 3.2 ms.

cause:the-8-downs-are-one-episode-not-ei.text: The 8 downs are one episode, not eight: the harness (_pt_calm) strips RM_PitDrowning but leaves RM_SwimExhaustion at 1 and the pawn in place, so drowning restarts at once, spaced ~2,000 ticks.

cause:the-8-ms-framebudgetms-bounds-edge.text: The 8 ms FrameBudgetMs bounds edge laying alone, so it did not cap the whole frame. At 15b1b2a51080 slices still hit 25.8 ms (C StandingLamp: bInputs 13.27 + bReduce 8.35, bEdges 0) and 20.4 ms (D PowerConduit).

cause:the-86-ms-slice-site-b-lamps-was.text: The 86 ms slice (site B lamps) was not a GSS phase: it froze the lay worker too (LayEdge 91 ms), so it was a process-wide pause. rebuildPhasesMs was only the last rebuild's split.

cause:the-86-ms-worst-slice-site-b-lamps.text: The 86 ms worst slice (site B lamps, round 8) was not a GSS phase: it froze the lay worker too (LayEdge 91 ms), so it was a process-wide pause.

cause:the-86-ms-worst-uncollected-slice-.text: The 86 ms worst uncollected slice (r8, site B lamps) was a process-wide pause, not a GSS phase: it froze the lay worker too (LayEdge 91 ms).

cause:the-87-first-sprawl-bends-were-not.text: The 87 first-sprawl bends were not fixable by the existing repair: SmoothBends rejects every window (turn/len, cut-keep guard), so the bends were already in the first sprawl.

cause:the-calm-v2-site-v1-v2-was-not.text: The calm v2 site (v1->v2) was not the cause, and neither was a GSS change since 2026-10-16; the cause was FlowWorks being co-loaded (deep swim).

cause:the-earlier-92-unforced-figure-was.text: The earlier '92 unforced' figure was not reproduced: the committed Diag.cs read 174 at 0416599c69's kernel (92 came from an earlier seed set).

cause:the-fault-check-s-assertion-builds.text: The fault check's assertion (Builds end equal to one unbudgeted Build after a graph-job fault) was not the fault: with the cap lifted the Builds end equal at 63 Builds (eq=True). Only the loop guard was too small.

cause:the-heap-port-bends-are-not-forced.text: The heap-port bends are not forced by walls: a bounded search (heap_escape_search.py) found a local way out at 21 of 21 ports.

cause:the-live-a1-fail-aerial-probe-time.text: The live A1 FAIL ('aerial probe timed out') was explained as a proof defect, not a mod defect: the binding has no site step, so with no current map AerialProbe.Service never runs.

cause:the-notch-under-the-strip-device-b.text: The notch under the strip-device boot was not caused by SeatPlugTails: it predated it, from the shadow ribbon's square start (ShadowTuck 0.08).

cause:the-pool-fix-still-breaks-20-ms-un.text: False theory: the pool fix still breaks 20 ms (untested, proof never reached GSS).

cause:the-spec-s-premise-that-a-polllive.text: The spec's premise that a PollLive flip 'only needs a reprint' is wrong: CordBuilder.Build reads isLive (LimpTail, live/dead decals), so a flip changes geometry and must rebuild; a topology revision would bump on nearly every regenerate.

cause:wall-device-plugs-being-rejected-a.text: Wall-device plugs being rejected: a re-read of current CordAudit.ArtFit shows it already accepts a HasHome wall-cell plug, so no defect remains.
